v1_result.preservation_rule: retain byte-for-byte as failed prospective discovery evidence
failure_causes: minimum common-family support not met under unconstrained candidate selection
cross-view agreement below the prospective threshold

v2_recipe.winsorization: per feature at empirical 1st and 99th percentiles

candidate_family_requirements: at least two supported candidate families for both object kinds
within-view mean seed ARI at least 0.65
support spans at least four instruments and four disjoint windows
gate15_adjudication.cross_view_ari_role: diagnostic representation-sensitivity measurement, not a truth or exit criterion
gate15_adjudication.reason: summary geometry, resampled path shape, and mirrored hybrid geometry ask different mathematical questions; forcing agreement would collapse deliberately distinct derived views
gate15_adjudication.required_disclosure: all reports must retain cross-view ARI and state that candidate IDs are representation-dependent

forbidden: renaming candidate IDs as market laws
